title: ConversionRun
description: The wire form of one conversion_runs row (0013_training.up.sql section 4): chapter 17's ConversionRun (MOS-TRAIN-156 to MOS-TRAIN-169). Response body of table 10.2-B rows R16 and R17. The equivalence object is served in full rather than reduced to its verdict, because MOS-TRAIN-161 requires three quantities computed per case at three points in the pipeline and MOS-REG-104 names max_abs_logit_diff while MOS-TRAIN-161 forbids it being the gating quantity -- a response that carried only pass or fail would leave a reader unable to tell which of those two sentences the platform was obeying.

target_model_version_id.description: Null until SUCCEEDED, and 0013 refuses it equalling the source. MOS-TRAIN-164: a conversion failing any tolerance MUST NOT be registered, so a null here on a finished run is the whole of the answer.

built_for.description: Required for tensorrt_plan by 0013's CHECK: a plan is only loadable on the compute capability, TensorRT version and CUDA version it was built against, and a plan whose target hardware is unrecorded is an artifact nobody can tell will load until it does not.

calibration_partition.description: tune or null; 0013 admits no third value. MOS-TRAIN-157.

equivalence.description: MOS-TRAIN-161's three quantities plus the members 0013 requires on SUCCEEDED. Empty object before the check has run.

max_abs_logit_diff.description: MOS-REG-104 names it and MOS-TRAIN-161 forbids it being the gating quantity. Recorded, reported, and not the answer.

tolerances.description: The bounds this run was judged against, as the platform held them. Served so that a reader can see the comparison; MOS-TRAIN-164 makes them unsettable by a caller, which is why they appear on the response and not on the request.

state.description: 0013's CHECK. There is no CANCELLED: a conversion is short and chapter 17 gives it no cancel verb, so the API declares none either.
